overview: Local-Eyes is a fully offline-first AI disaster assistance app for India. It features a dual-mode AI chatbot (works with or without internet), comprehensive survival and first-aid guides with 1000+ India-specific references, interactive maps for Andhra Pradesh and Vijayawada, 22+ emergency contacts, hazard detection, multilingual support (Telugu, English, Hindi), voice input, and photo-based emergency identification.
features: Dual-mode AI chatbot (offline 1000+ scenarios + online Gemini with live web search)
Auto online/offline detection with instant mode switching
Fully accessible — ARIA landmarks, keyboard nav, screen reader support, 48px touch targets
Child-friendly UX designed for ease of use at any age
Multilingual: Telugu, English, Hindi with voice input
1000+ India-specific survival, medical, and disaster scenarios
Photo-based emergency identification (cyclone, flood, fire, burns, etc.)
Interactive offline maps: Andhra Pradesh, Vijayawada, India-wide
3D UI with card flip animations and performance fallbacks for low-power devices
